definitions.gloss: to keep, to hold, to take custody of
definitions.explanation: To temporarily hold or look after something for someone else.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かって⟦もらえます→もらう：00520_morau⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Could you hold my luggage for me?

examples.japanese: お⟦{子|こ}さん→子：09851_ko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かります。
⟦{鍵|かぎ}→鍵：02189_kagi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かっています。
⟦{大事|だいじ}な→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かった。
examples.english: I was entrusted with important documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧、⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ペット→ペット：02959_petto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{預|あず}かって⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my neighbor look after my pet while I was traveling.

notes:
{預|あず}かる means to keep something for someone.

PAIR VERB:
- {預|あず}かる: to keep (for someone) [receiver]
- {預|あず}ける: to entrust, deposit [giver]

COMMON USES:
- {荷物|にもつ}を{預|あず}かる: to hold luggage
- お{金|かね}を{預|あず}かる: to hold money
- {子供|こども}を{預|あず}かる: to look after children

Note: Godan verb (う-verb).
